routeNotFoundBody: The address does not match any screen in this application.
setupBody: Docknight has a single account. Choose its username and password.
setupMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setupStrengthHint: At least 8 characters, and two of letters, digits, symbols.
loginTotpBody: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator.
dashboardConvertBody: Paste a docker run command line. It is parsed, never executed.
dashboardHostsBody: Each host runs its own Docknight. The credentials stored here are that host's own administrator account.
dashboardHostRemoveBody: Docknight will close the link to {url} and forget its credentials. The host itself is untouched.
stackNameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore. Up to 63 characters.
stackUnmanagedBody: Docker reports it, but there is no directory for it under the stacks directory, so Docknight cannot read or edit its files.
stackNotFoundBody: It may have been removed from another session.
stackLeaveBody: The compose file has unsaved edits. Leaving discards them.
stackDeleteBody: Docknight runs compose down and then removes the whole directory, including files it does not manage.
serviceRemoveBody: The service is removed from the compose file. Nothing is deployed until you deploy.
terminalDescription: Live terminal output. Press Escape then Tab to leave it.
terminalKeyCtrlHint: Sends the next letter as a control character.
consoleBody: A full shell as the user Docknight runs as. It is not sandboxed.
consoleDisabledBody: Start Docknight with --enable-console to turn it on.
settingsPrimaryHostnameHint: Used to build the links on service port chips.
settingsTrustProxyHint: Turn this on only when a reverse proxy you control sets the header.
settingsAutoUpgradeHint: Run the upgrade as soon as the update check finds a newer release.
settingsUpgradeHint: The new image is pulled first, then this container is replaced. Running stacks are left alone.
settingsUpgradeBody: Docknight is unreachable for a few seconds while the container is replaced. The browser reconnects on its own.
settingsPasswordChanged: The password was changed and every other session was signed out.
settingsTotpScan: Scan this with your authenticator, or type the secret in by hand.
settingsDisableAuthHint: Every visitor becomes the administrator. Only sensible behind another authenticating proxy on a trusted network.
settingsDisableAuthBody: Anyone who reaches this address will hold the docker socket. Enter the current password to confirm.
settingsGlobalEnvBody: Applied to every stack as an additional env file, before each stack's own .env.
settingsAboutKeyWarning: Removing agent-key from the data directory makes the stored credentials of every managed host unrecoverable. The recovery is to add the hosts again.
errorDisconnected: The connection closed before the server answered.
errorTimeout: The server did not answer in time.
invalidStackName: That stack name is not acceptable: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore only.
invalidYAML: The compose file does not parse.
invalidCompose: The compose file must be a mapping at its root.
servicesMustBeObject: services must be a mapping of service names.
invalidEnvFormat: {file} line {line} is neither blank, a comment, nor KEY=value.
composeFileTooLarge: {name} is larger than 1 MiB, which is more than the editor handles.
operationInProgress: Another command is already running on {name}.
composeCommandFailed: docker compose exited {code}. The output is in the command pane.
dockerUnavailable: Docker is not reachable. Check the socket mount and the daemon.
composerizeFailed: That does not read as a docker run command.
passwordTooWeak: That password is too weak: at least 8 characters and two of letters, digits, symbols.
authIncorrectCreds: That username and password are not accepted.
authInvalidToken: That code is wrong, expired, or already used.
authSessionExpired: That session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
authIncorrectPassword: The current password did not verify.
tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
terminalNotFound: That terminal is no longer running.
serviceNotFound: That service is not part of this stack.
unsupportedShell: Only sh, bash, ash and zsh are available.
consoleDisabled: The host console is turned off on this host.
terminalNotJoined: This view is not attached to that terminal.
upgradeUnavailable: Docknight cannot upgrade itself from here.
upgradeNotContainer: Docknight is not running in a container, so it cannot replace itself. Update it the way you installed it.
upgradeNoSocket: The docker socket is not mounted, so the upgrade cannot reach the daemon.
upgradeSelfUnknown: Docknight cannot work out which container it is running in.
upgradeNotCompose: This container was not started by docker compose, so there is no compose file to recreate it from.
upgradePullFailed: The new image could not be pulled. This container is untouched.
upgradeHandoffFailed: The replacement container could not be started.
invalidAgentUrl: That is not an http or https URL.
agentTimeout: The host accepted the request and did not answer.
agentKeyUnreadable: The stored credentials cannot be decrypted. The agent key file is missing or unreadable.
agentOfflineBanner: {host} is offline. Actions are disabled until it returns.
